description: Quadrant Future Tek Limited, a research-oriented company, develops and sells train control and signaling systems in India. The company offers train control systems, such as train collision avoidance and electronic interlocking systems; and interconnect products, including electrical connectors and wiring harness products. It also provides specialty cables comprising railway rolling stock and naval defense industry; and renewable energy, automotive, and railway signalling cables. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Mohali, India.
